positions.name: Motorola Solutions, Inc.
positions.catalyst: Q2 2026 beat-and-raise (pre-mkt Aug 6, reported Aug 5 AH): adj EPS $4.41 vs $3.89 est; revenue $3.13B (+13.3% YoY) vs $3.03B est. Raised FY26 revenue to $12.975B from $12.8B and FY non-GAAP EPS to $17.62-17.72 from $16.87-16.99. Record backlog $15.6B (+11% YoY); Silvus + public-safety LMR driving the raise.
positions.driver: Clean beat-and-raise on a defensive mega-cap; ~$73B public-safety/government franchise with record backlog gives revenue visibility and downside protection. Only ~+5% pre-market (room to run vs 8-10% chase cap) with a definable stop.
positions.risks: Thin/wide pre-market spread (bid 450 / ask 470) = fill risk; mega-cap caps 24h upside vs small-caps; government-budget/spending headlines; broad-market rotation; gap-fill if beat already partly priced.
